name: Floor coordinator
design: Medium stocky male with olive-black mottling, broad exposed four-mandibled face, high ridged dome, short thick dreadlocks. Cropped black civilian vest over ochre half-sleeve tunic, heavy leather utility apron and broad belt. A compact chalk-line marking spool in left hand, capped short floor-marker in right hand, simple practical stance with feet apart. Clearly logistics official, no rake, no battle weapon.
